# ennabl Design Tokens

These tokens are injected into every builder preview. Use them directly — no imports needed.

**Golden rule: always use tokens instead of raw values.**
- Use `var(--en-space-4)` not `16px`
- Use `var(--en-primary)` not `#0000C5`
- Use `className="en-body2"` not `font: 400 14px/20px ...`

---

## Spacing

- `--en-space` = `4px` — base unit

## Typography Classes

Apply with `className`. Font is Inter (loaded via @font-face).
